name: Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co.,Ltd
summary: Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co.,Ltd. develops, produces, and sells various types of heavy-duty vehicles, special vehicles, specialized vehicles, engines, transmissions, axles, and other assemblies and automotive components in China. It also offers medium and heavy trucks, light trucks, new energy vehicles, coaches, and light vehicles. The company provides its products under the Yellow River, SITRAK, and HOWO brand names. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as CNHTC Jinan Truck Co.,Ltd. Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Jinan, China. Sinotruk Jinan Truck Co.,Ltd (SZSE:000951) operates as a subsidiary of Sinotruk (Hong Kong) Limited.
